01

“Have you seen the one who forbids a servant when he prays?”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 96:10).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
Have you seen the one who forbids a servant when he prays? [al-ʿAlaq: 10], he said: “meaning Abu Jahl ibn Hisham, who used to forbid the Prophet (ﷺ) from praying.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَى عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّى [العلق: 10] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي أَبَا جَهْلِ بْنَ هِشَامٍ كَانَ يَنْهَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ»

02

“let him call his associates”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 96:17).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
let him call his associates [al-ʿAlaq: 17], meaning: “his clan,” meaning Abu Jahl.
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ [العلق: 17] ، يَعْنِي: " عَشِيرَتَهُ يَعْنِي: أَبَا جَهْلٍ "
Edition record 373886 · p. 739Link to report ↗
03

“We will call the guards of Hell (zabaniyah)”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 96:18).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
We will call the guards of Hell (zabaniyah) [al-ʿAlaq: 18], he said: “The zabaniyah are the angels.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ [العلق: 18] قَالَ: " الزَّبَانِيَةُ: الْمَلَائِكَةُ "
